title: More_tool
description: this mod adds more tool like "lightning_sword"
body: This mod adds more items to the game, such as swords and ore. I will be developing it further in the future. "lightning_sword" This sword sends lightning bolts through the mob you hit. Be careful, it also takes damage to you. "dark_blade" This sword is normal but deals very high damage. "error" This mob will not attack you unless you hit it, but it will attack you if you hit it.
